answer: A rotating juniper-seeded challenge round then forces each agent to prove live control of its stake, so clones cannot reuse one bond. Every agent must stake a bond on a public ledge tied to a hardware-attested identity; to forge a duplicate persona, an attacker must acquire and bond fresh hardware, costing real capital per sybil. Duplicates are slashed, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
